title: If every ticked customer left the term meanwhile, the move is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Sign in with the "Admin" role in one browser, and have a second user, user B, signed in with the "Admin" role in a second browser.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, customer A.
  • Start with your browser showing the Credit Terms page and user B's browser showing Edit Customer for customer A.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. In user B's browser, set Credit Terms to Net 60.
  5. In user B's browser, click Save.
  6. In your browser, click "Move 1 Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • The button reads "Move 1 Customer".

Step 4:

  • The dropdown shows Net 60.

Step 5:

  • Customer A is saved on Net 60.

Step 6:

  • The app's error alert shows "Pick at least one customer to move." and the window stays open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If every ticked customer has left the term before the confirm, the move is refused and the app's standard error alert shows "Pick at least one customer to move." The window stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move with no ticked customer still on the term (server) | "Pick at least one customer to move." | Standard error alert, window stays open”
